## What is this about?

<!-- generated by aider + aider-skills + skill create-blog-entry-what-is-this-about -->
The repository contains a minimal HTML game prototype created with the p5.js library. It uses a simple grid of random numbers to drive gameplay, with score calculation and level progression based on a three‑star rating system. The design intentionally avoids complex graphics, relying only on basic text and line drawing to keep the project lightweight and easy to understand. This approach makes the code a useful learning example for developers who want to explore canvas‑based game mechanics without the overhead of large frameworks.
